objective.title: Qualify isolated Math NuGet consumers and convention-preserving primitive proposals

declared.summary: Qualify an independent .NET 10 package-only consumer of dw.quantities and dw.tools.math.statistics, demonstrating loss-refusing exact scaling, explicit Type-7 versus nearest-rank quantiles, exact and compensated sums, typed Pearson, Bernoulli and seeded checkpoint oracles. Verify 31 named probes, local-only NuGet manifests and artifact SHA-256s. Complete C04-T1 and A/B/C while leaving C04/T2 for Decision/MCDM ownership review.
declared.value: Provide evidence that generic Math primitives are usable outside AURA without silently adopting Decision risk semantics or MCDM ranking behavior; retain versioned package identity and explicit numerical conventions.
debtChanges: An isolated package-only executable, not a sibling Decision/MCDM implementation, checks exact scaling with deliberate fractional and Int64 overflow refusal.
Exact rational results and finite binary64 arithmetic remain separate; consumer snapshots carry explicit Type-7 or nearest-rank quantile convention.
Defined Pearson and typed undefined constant-vector Pearson remain distinct; no null correlation is treated as numeric zero.
The consumer replays a golden SplitMix64/v1 word and strict seed/counter checkpoint without claiming cryptographic randomness.
Pinned local dw.quantities preview.1 and statistics preview.6 packages are packed, inspected and restored without external NuGet feeds.
Math owns only consumer evidence and candidate primitive documentation. Draft Decision and MCDM requests remain unsent and recipient 1.x/business contracts untouched.
C04-T2 still owns comparative recipient semantics and adoption boundaries; C04 and M3-W02 are not completed by this T1 run.
declared.nextAction: After durable RS050 success, prepare M3-W02-C04-T2 to resolve Decision/MCDM ownership boundaries, refine unsent Math requests with exact package evidence and preserve recipient-specific tests and semantics.

achievements.achievement: Fix the accepted C04-T1 question and explicit pass/fail oracles for independently consumable Math packages, exact-scale refusal, named quantiles and nonadoption boundaries.

Build and execute a separately restored package-only .NET 10 consumer with 31 independent mathematical oracles and record exact NuGet package IDs, dependencies, versions, SHA-256s and runtime evidence.
Document safe reusable primitive proposals and alternatives for Decision/MCDM while keeping ownership, draft-request status and non-cryptographic/precision limitations explicit.
Qualify M3-W02-C04-T1 as an independently tested mathematical consumer and documented primitive proposal, leaving C04-T2 and recipient implementation outside this run.
